name: Vse hotjat v Sovjonok
source: Probably, we all wanted to get into "Sovyonok", or at least imagined ourselves in Semyon's place? This story is exactly about that imaginary scenario: a person who has played the game magically ends up in the same pioneer camp. Or maybe he doesn't, everything here depends only on you!
